import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0228 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ α) (hY : Y ⊆ α) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0228 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ α) (hY : Y ⊆ α) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, haX_or_Y⟩ := Set.mem_union.1 hb
  obtain haX | haY := by
    cases haX_or_Y with a haX haY
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ haX
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ haY
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0228 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0228 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0228

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0228
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0228
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
